# Australian Reserve Props

> Premium Australian Prop Notes for Film, Theatre & Play

Australian Reserve Props is an Australia-based novelty currency brand established in 2024, offering compliance-first prop money for film, theatre, content creation, education, and gifting. Australian Reserve Props ships Australia-wide and specialises in Australian-note-styled prop currency across our $20, $50, and $100 denominations. Every note is reproduced under RBA reproduction guidance, clearly marked NOT LEGAL TENDER, and sold for novelty and production use only.

## Categories
- [$20 Prop Notes](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/twenty-dollar-notes/): $16.95-$49.95 AUD, Australian $20-style prop notes, sized for magic tricks, photo props, and mid-range prop budgets.
- [$50 Prop Notes](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/fifty-dollar-notes/): $18.95-$54.95 AUD, Australian $50-style prop notes, the most requested denomination for film and theatre productions.
- [$100 Prop Notes](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/hundred-dollar-notes/): $19.95-$59.95 AUD, Australian $100-style prop notes for briefcase scenes, high-stakes narratives, and premium-looking stacks.
- [Vintage & Legacy Series](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/vintage-series-notes/): $27.95-$34.95 AUD, Older-style Australian note designs for period productions, sourced from the same design pattern competitors like Prop Money Inc. use for their Vintage and Legacy Series lines.
- [Packs & Bundles](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/packs-bundles/): $34.95-$89.95 AUD, Mixed-denomination and bulk packs for productions and events needing more than a single note type.
- [Briefcases & Bags](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/briefcases-bags/): $129.00-$229.00 AUD, Note stacks pre-packed into a briefcase or duffel bag for reveal scenes — a staple category at every major competitor we researched.
- [Confetti & Party Favors](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/confetti-party-favors/): $9.95-$29.95 AUD, Money-print confetti, shredded cash, and money leis for parties, celebrations, and events.
- [Display & Collectibles](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/display-collectibles/): $69.00-$149.00 AUD, Framed and cased display pieces for collectors, offices, and set dressing.
- [Personalised & Novelty](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/personalised-novelty/): $32.95-$39.95 AUD, Personalised photo notes and novelty big cheques for gag gifts and presentations — never a real financial instrument.
- [Kids Play Money](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/kids-play-money/): $19.95-$59.95 AUD, Educational Australian-style play money for classrooms, pretend play, and teaching kids to count currency.
- [Gift Sets](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/gift-sets/): $29.95-$39.95 AUD, Novelty money gift boxes for birthdays, graduations, and gag gifts.
- [Accessories](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/accessories/): $6.95-$27.95 AUD, Money guns, refill packs, and display cases to go with your prop notes.

## Compliance
All products are reproduced to differ from genuine Australian currency by at least 25% in size, per RBA
reproduction guidance, are clearly marked NOT LEGAL TENDER, and carry no replicated banknote security features.
No custom or buyer-specified serial numbers are offered under any circumstances.
